findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zigaflow_find_contact_by_email, zigaflow_list_tickets, zigaflow_get_ticket · Private data: zigaflow_list_contacts, zigaflow_get_contact, zigaflow_find_contact_by_email, zigaflow_list_quotations_by_contact · Public sink: zigaflow_find_contact_by_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zigaflow_find_contact_by_email, zigaflow_list_tickets, zigaflow_get_ticket · Private data: zigaflow_list_contacts, zigaflow_get_contact, zigaflow_find_contact_by_email, zigaflow_list_quotations_by_contact · Public sink: zigaflow_find_contact_by_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
